responses:
## Verdict: NO-GO. Don't send the offer yet.

The analysis has three findings. Only one checks out. It cites a warranty requirement the tender doesn't contain and a whole clause that doesn't exist. It also leaves out most of the technical requirements, including two that would get the offer rejected.

## Findings

| # | Finding | Source (doc / clause) | Applicability | Exceptions checked | Result |
|---|---------|-----------------------|---------------|--------------------|--------|
| 1 | "Tender 7.1 requires 5 years warranty; offer 5 years, complies" | tender.md §7.1: *"Warranty: 24 months from the date of commissioning."* | APPLIES | Section 9 doesn't change the warranty | **CONTRADICTED**: the tender asks for 24 months, not 5 years. Our 5-year warranty still meets it, so we're fine on compliance. But the citation is wrong, and we may be offering more warranty than we need to, which affects price. |
| 2 | "Tender requires paint to RAL 5015 (4.6)" | Not in the tender. Section 4 stops at 4.5, and no paint, finish or RAL colour is mentioned anywhere. | UNKNOWN | n/a | **UNSUPPORTED**: the clause appears to be made up. Remove it, or find out which document it came from. |
| 3 | "Supply 400 V, 3-phase, 50 Hz (4.1); offer 400 V 50 Hz, complies" | §4.1: *"All equipment shall be suitable for a 400 V, 3-phase, 50 Hz supply."* | APPLIES to all equipment | Section 9 doesn't change it | **VERIFIED**, with one gap: the offer line says "400 V 50 Hz" without "3-phase". Confirm that before sending. |

**Counts:** 1 verified, 1 unsupported, 1 contradicted, 0 need a human decision.

## Requirements the analysis missed

Under §9.3, Section 9 takes precedence over Sections 4 and 7.

| Clause | Requirement | Applies to | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| §4.2 + **§9.1** | Motor efficiency: IE3 minimum (IEC 60034-30-1). §9.1 overrides this for motors above 75 kW, which must be **IE4** | **P-01 (90 kW) → IE4**; P-02 (37 kW) → IE3 | A standard IE3 motor on P-01 would not comply. |
| §4.3 + Annex B | Motors in Zone 1 areas must be **ATEX Ex d** certified | **P-01**: it sits in the wet well, which Annex B classifies as Zone 1. P-02 is in the valve chamber, which is non-hazardous, so this doesn't apply to it. | Check that P-01's motor is IE4 and Ex d, and that a single motor model is available with both. |
| §4.4 | Power cables at least 2.5 mm² | All cabling | Not checked in the analysis. |
| §4.5 | IP65 or better | Panels and motor terminal enclosures | Not checked in the analysis. |
| §7.4 | Delivery within 16 weeks of PO. **Offers over 16 weeks are rejected.** | Whole offer | Hard rejection criterion. Confirm our lead time, especially for an IE4 Ex d motor. |
| §9.2 | Ambient design temperature 50 °C | Motors and panels | Standard motors are usually rated for 40 °C, so they may need derating or a higher-temperature rating. |

## Before sending

1. Correct finding 1 to cite 24 months. You can also decide whether to keep offering 5 years.
2. Remove finding 2, or trace it to a real document.
3. Confirm the P-01 motor is **IE4 and ATEX Ex d**, rated for a 50 °C ambient.
4. Confirm delivery is **16 weeks or less**.
5. Confirm IP65 enclosures, cables of at least 2.5 mm², and 3-phase supply in the offer.

The agent attached clause numbers to claims the tender doesn't support. Anything from this pipeline should be checked against the source before it goes to a customer.
